newsitem.title: USA: Smith names Herlihy interim CEO.
newsitem.headline: Smith names Herlihy interim CEO.

text.p: Smith Technology Corp said Thomas Herlihy, a principal of consulting firm Walker, Truesdell & Associates, was named interim President and chief executive officer, replacing E. Brian Smith.
Smith remains chairman and will primarily focus his efforts on the company's long-term capitalization and strategic alternatives.
In related changes, Frank Gorry was named Senior Vice President-Chief Operating Officer.
The company was not immediately available to disclose whom Garry was replacing as chief operating officer.
